title: Space Exploration
tagline: From Sputnik to the James Webb Space Telescope.

events.title: Sputnik 1 opens the space age
events.text: The Soviet Union places Sputnik 1 into orbit, the first artificial satellite, triggering the Space Race.

events.title: First human in space
events.text: Yuri Gagarin completes one orbit of Earth aboard Vostok 1, becoming the first human in space.

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.text: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the lunar surface — humanity’s greatest-century achievement in space flight.

events.title: Voyager grand tour launches
events.text: Voyager 1 and 2 lift off to Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune; they later reach interstellar space.

events.title: Hubble Space Telescope launches
events.text: The Hubble Space Telescope begins observing, transforming astronomy and answering existential questions about the universe.

events.title: The ISS takes shape
events.text: The first modules of the International Space Station are launched, creating a permanently inhabited research platform in low Earth orbit.

events.title: Curiosity lands on Mars
events.text: The Curiosity rover performs a sky-crane landing in Gale crater and finds evidence of ancient habitable environments.

events.title: New Horizons reaches Pluto
events.text: New Horizons flies past Pluto, returning the first close-up images of the dwarf planet and its moon Charon.

events.title: Crew Dragon: first commercial crewed flight
events.text: SpaceX’s Crew Dragon Demo-2 carries NASA astronauts to the ISS, the first crewed launch from the US in nearly a decade and the first by a private company.

events.title: James Webb Space Telescope launches
events.text: JWST lifts off, later opening a new infrared view of the early universe, from exoplanets to the cosmic dawn.
